build.command: for f in $(git ls-files 'src/*.ts' 'bin/*.ts'); do bun build "$f" --target=bun --outfile=/dev/null >/dev/null || exit 1; done

other_hosts.command: git ls-files adapters commands/orly.toml gemini-extension.json GEMINI.md .codex-plugin .cursor-plugin .agents scripts

missing_docs.command: grep -oh 'docs/[a-z/-]*\.txt' llms.txt README.md | sort -u | while read d; do [ -f "$d" ] || echo "MISSING $d"; done

taste_rejected.command: d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; printf 'Is the code clean and readable after this turn?\n' > "$d/.orly/specs/t.spec"; (cd "$d" && TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" specs >/dev/null 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 2 ]

malformed_blocks.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; printf 'bogus: 1

A question here?
' > "$d/.orly/specs/bad.spec"; out=$(cd "$d" && echo '{"turn":{"user_request":"x","assistant_final_message":"done","assistant_said":"done","actions_taken":["Bash: ls"],"command_results":["ok"],"conclusive":true}}' | TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" judge 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 2 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q bad

check_first.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; printf 'require: checks.never.exit equals 0

The check passes.
' > "$d/.orly/specs/c.spec"; printf '{"checks":{"never":{"command":"false"}}}' > "$d/.orly/config.json"; out=$(cd "$d" && echo '{"turn":{"user_request":"x","assistant_final_message":"done","assistant_said":"done","actions_taken":["Bash: ls"],"command_results":["ok"],"conclusive":true}}' | TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" judge 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 2 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q never

eval_statuses.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; cd "$d"; git init -q; printf 'require: checks.ok.exit equals 0

Passes.
' > .orly/specs/a.spec; printf 'require: checks.bad.exit equals 0

Fails.
' > .orly/specs/b.spec; printf 'Does the turn run the tests after the last edit?
' > .orly/specs/c.spec; printf '{"checks":{"ok":{"command":"true"},"bad":{"command":"false"}}}' > .orly/config.json; out=$(TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 2 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q "^satisfied .*a" && echo "$out" | grep -q "^violated .*b" && echo "$out" | grep -q "^unknown .*c"

eval_reuse.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; cd "$d"; git init -q; printf 'require: checks.ok.exit equals 0

Passes.
' > .orly/specs/a.spec; printf '{"checks":{"ok":{"command":"echo ran >> ran.log"}}}' > .orly/config.json; echo ran.log > .gitignore; git add -A; git commit -qm x; TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval 2>&1); n=$(wc -l < ran.log); rm -rf "$d"; [ "$n" -eq 1 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q "1 reused"

eval_change.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; cd "$d"; git init -q; printf 'require: checks.flag.exit equals 0

The flag file exists.
' > .orly/specs/flag.spec; printf '{"checks":{"flag":{"command":"test -f flag"}}}' > .orly/config.json; git add -A; git commit -qm x; TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval >/dev/null 2>&1; touch flag; out=$(TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 0 ] && echo "$out" | grep -q "improved.*flag"

eval_unassessed.command:
d=$(mktemp -d); r=$PWD; mkdir -p "$d/.orly/specs"; cd "$d"; git init -q; printf 'require: checks.ok.exit equals 0

Passes.
' > .orly/specs/a.spec; printf '{"checks":{"ok":{"command":"true"}}}' > .orly/config.json; echo x > orphan.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm x; out=$(TYPESAFE_API_KEY= ORLY_KEY_COMMAND=: bun "$r/bin/orly.ts" eval 2>&1); rm -rf "$d"; echo "$out" | grep -q "unassessed.*orphan.txt"
